The camera holds a static shot as the SUV's brake lights settle, the engine starts, and the vehicle pulls away smoothly and steadily at a safe, calm pace, rolling forward along the lane and gradually receding into the distance, progressively approaching the framing of Picture 2 until the car has driven out toward the far end of the frame at the end of the shot, matching the composition of Picture 2.
